title: The Holy Spirit is for Everyone
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner unpacks the significance of the day of Pentecost and what it means for every believer to receive the Holy Spirit. He tackles common misconceptions about the Holy Spirit and invites listeners to experience the transformative power of God's presence in their lives. Join Pastor Chris as he shares a message of hope, freedom, and empowerment for every individual to live a life full of the Spirit.
